context.body: The divided heart of 1 Kings 11 leaves a material landscape that survives for generations.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Josiah defiles Topheth, removes royal horses and chariots dedicated to the sun, destroys altars, and defiles the high places Solomon built for foreign gods.
observations.label: Josiah destroys Solomon’s high places: action

observations.body: A later reform names Solomon’s worship sites among entrenched structures requiring removal.
observations.label: Josiah destroys Solomon’s high places: response

observations.body: high places · Solomon king of Israel · Ashtoreth · defiled

payload.posture: Read 2 Kings 23:10–15 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage remembers Solomon through what later faithfulness must tear down.
payload.title: Josiah destroys Solomon’s high places
